description: Phase 4 (handoff §1a): Three Wolves' row in tenants gets its words for a player and a pair, for the shared match tracker: terms.player_name, terms.players_name, terms.pair_name (Wolf, Wolves, Pack) and the Vietnamese ones under terms.localized.vi (Sói, Sói, Bầy). They equal the built-in settings in lib/constants.ts, so the settings shadow stops reporting a difference (audit C0). One row of one platform table changes; keys are added, nothing is removed or renamed. No account, email, phone, session, role, membership or club-owned row may change. Rehearsal on a Neon branch of production, so nothing is volatile.
